Best Value Electric Bicycles for Adults in Canada

ARIES 27.5" E-Bike: Urban & Mountain Enthusiast's Choice - High-Performance Adult Electric Bicycle with Pedal Assist

How to Assemble Your 27.5-Inch ARIES Electric Mountain Bikehttps://youtu.be/gRGvTMQqWoc

Pedal assist bicycles are electric motor assisted bikes. The function of the pedal assist is to augment the rider's own physical power to save energy.

Up to 90 KM Travel Range - Equipped with a 48V 11.6AH ( 556.8Wh ) high capacity battery, this e-bike can achieve up to 80-90 KM (50-56 miles) under Pedal Assist Mode or up to 40-48 KM (25-30 miles) under Pure Electric Mode. 2 Ways of Charging: 1. Charge the e-bike directly. 2. Unlock the battery and charge it at home.

Power Through Hills - The Rated 500W, 1000W Peak Power brushless motor delivers enhanced hill-climbing capabilities, max slope of 25 degree. Take on daunting inclines with more power - even at lower speeds. Thanks to the high torque brusless motor, this e-bike can easily reach top speed of 32 KM/H (20 MPH). You can overcome most of mountains with professional 7-speed transmission system.

Ride in Comfort - The lockable fork suspension can effectively weaken the strong impact from mountains and rocks. 27.5" large shock-absorbing air tires can easily across pit and obstacle. The ergonomic seat with air cushion shock absorber makes you relax all the time. You can easily control headlight, switch speed mode, activate the horn by pressing corresponding button once.

Safe to Ride - The large size Front-n-rear disc braking system give you strong confidence to ride at anytime and anywhere, ultra bright LED headlight and electronic horn keep you safe during night commuting. A 5-level LCD display in the middle of the handlebar makes it easy and safe to read riding status without taking your eyes off the direction of riding. Max load is 120 KG (265 lbs).

Professional Service - This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled, you can finish the assembly within minutes. This E-bike has also 5 speed modes, Cruise Control and Push-assist function. We've prepared a series of tutorial videos on the product page for your reference. One-year or 180-day warranty for different parts. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us. We're here to help you.
